name: New Asset Report
query:
select distinct t1.voucher_no 'Journal Entry:Link/Journal Entry', 
				t1.against_voucher 'Asset:Link/Asset',
				t1.account,
				t1.cost_center 'Cost Center',
				t1.debit,
				t1.credit
			from `tabGL Entry` t1
			inner join `tabAccount` a on a.name = t1.account
			where t1.cbs_enabled = 1
			and t1.is_cancelled = 0
			and t1.voucher_no in (
				select je.parent
            	from `tabJournal Entry Account` je, tabAsset a 
            	where a.name=je.reference_name and a.name in ( select name from tabAsset where is_existing_asset=0 and available_for_use_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s and docstatus=1) 
            	and je.account='120060004 - Stock Asset - BDBL' group by a.name
			)
			and not exists(select 1
				from `tabCBS Entry Upload` ceu
				where ceu.gl_entry = t1.name
				and ceu.docstatus != 2)
		group by voucher_no
		order by posting_date, voucher_type, voucher_no
